0022600135.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-1, 6th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 1 game back) are 0-1 at home and 2-0 on the road as they play their fifth game of the 2026-27 season against the Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East), who are on a one-game losing streak. Indiana is without Andrew Nembhard (back, soreness), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle, sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring, strain), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain) and has Jabari Walker, Joel Embiid and VJ Edgecombe listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost all four games to the 76ers, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10.
